Hi all,

Quick answers below — happy to provide a redacted package. I attached the redwood-pen-test-summary-redacted-2026-09.pdf and the remediation-tracker-NordicBank.xlsx to this message for NordicBank's review.

Methodology:
- Performed by: SentinelGate Security (third-party firm; ISO 27001 certified; lead testers hold OSCP/CISSP).
- Coverage: External network, authenticated application-layer testing against our production staging environment (no access to PII datasets). Limited internal network testing was included as scoping for privileged admin services only; full internal segmentation tests are performed on annual engagements or upon customer request.
- Approach: a mix of automated scanning (credentialed where applicable), manual verification of high/critical findings, and exploitation attempts for confirmed critical vectors. Report includes CVSS, reproduction steps, and risk rating. Workpapers are maintained by SentinelGate.

Report age and acceptance:
- The attached report is dated 2026-09-15. Our security posture guidance: we accept reports up to 12 months old for procurement review if the vendor: (a) provides a remediation tracker showing fixes or mitigations for any critical/high findings, and (b) commits to a retest plan for remaining issues within 60 days of contract signature. For anything older than 12 months we require either a fresh assessment or a focused verification on externally facing assets.
- If a customer requires a shorter window we will accommodate; this is handled case-by-case by Security + Sales.

Workpapers and redaction:
- SentinelGate retains full workpapers (exploit scripts, logs) and we do not share raw workpapers by default. We can provide a redacted summary plus a remediation tracker off the live project folder. If NordicBank requires workpapers, we will need a mutual NDA and a secure transfer method (SFTP or enterprise Drive link) and it will be a time-boxed, monitored disclosure.

Retest options and timeline:
- Full retest: Scheduleable within 30–45 days of request subject to SentinelGate availability (standard SOW add-on).
- Focused verification: We can run a targeted verification of closed/high items on a 7–14 day cadence for critical procurement needs; this is treated as an expedited verification and billed accordingly.

Next steps I recommend:
1) NordicBank reviews the attached redacted report and remediation tracker.
2) If procurement needs workpapers, confirm NDA and transfer method; security will draft the minimal NDA.
3) If NordicBank needs a retest before Dec 10, let us know and we will try to secure expedited verification (subject to fee).

Happy to join a call with Lars this week.

Best,

Lars — following up with final proposed acceptance language for your procurement board. We discussed offline with Security and here is a concise statement you can include in your board packet: 

1) Report acceptance: Redwood provides a redacted pen test report dated 2026-09-15. NordicBank may accept this report for procurement purposes if the following conditions are met by contract signature:
   - A remediation tracker showing all critical/high findings with statuses is provided (attached).
   - Remediation for any critical findings is completed and independently verified by SentinelGate or a mutually agreed third party within 60 days of signature.

2) Workpapers: Full workpapers are held by SentinelGate. If NordicBank requires workpapers, a mutual NDA and secure transfer will be executed; turnaround for a sanitized package is typically 7–10 business days after NDA execution.

3) External asset coverage: The assessment covered public-facing infrastructure including CDN endpoints and the OAuth provider integration used for SSO. We have flagged these in the remediation tracker and indicated verification status where available.

4) Retest options: Redwood can schedule an expedited verification (7–14 business days) or a full retest (30–45 days) depending on scope. Expedited verifications are scoped to confirmed fixes and billed as a verification engagement.
